text:
nina: FYI publishing the JS SDK for samplekit failed the release job. auto-release picked a minor because typegen started wrapping exported interfaces with Readonly<> (regen-only), which bumped the declared surface.
ci-bot: build #4910 failed at publish: exit code 1. logs: https://ci.example.com/4910
arjun: ugh. do we have a minimal diff?
claire: pasted snippet from generated types:```diff
- export interface Config { apiKey?: string; timeoutMs?: number }
+ export type Config = Readonly<{ apiKey?: string; timeoutMs?: number }>
```That turned an interface -> type+Readonly which our semver checker treats as a minor change.
oscar: why did typegen flip to emitting type aliases + Readonly? I thought that was opt-in.
nina: looks like a dependent upgrade in tools/typegen (v3.1.0) defaulted to "preferReadonly": true. local regen reproduces it: `./scripts/typegen --out=generated --preferReadonly`.
arjun: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) revert the typegen bump in the release branch, 2) change the auto-release rule to ignore Readonly wrappers as non-breaking, 3) add a CI step that diffs generated/ and blocks publish if only stylistic changes present.
claire: for (2) changelog-bot currently runs `semver-check --diff` and returns "minor". we could add a normalization pass that strips Readonly<> and type->interface canonicalization before semver analysis.
oscar: for (3) I can add a deterministic normalization script: `node tools/normalize-generated.js generated/` that rewrites types into a canonical interface shape purely for diffing. then semver-check runs on normalized outputs.
arjun: also we're seeing flaky onboarding e2e failures tied to auth/retry: sample-app test uses a mocked auth server that returns 401 then 200 and our retry logic mutates the request body, causing nondeterministic fails in CI and sometimes makes publish time out.
claire: I'll update the harness to deep-clone the request before retry so retry is idempotent. quick patch in tests: `const reqCopy = structuredClone(req)` and re-send.
nina: owners? we need someone to: A) revert or pin typegen in release CI, B) implement normalization for semver checks, C) fix test harness cloning.
oscar: I'll own B and open a PR with normalize script + tests.
claire: taking C, will push a tiny test-only change.
arjun: I'll do A 0min revert to pin v3.0.5 in the release job and coordinate a canary publish once CI is green.
devex-bot: created ticket #1023 "typegen preferReadonly defaults caused auto-minor publish" and linked CI failure https://ci.example.com/4910
changelog-bot: noted: skipping auto-release for builds with label "regen-only". will apply once label is present on the PR.
nina: thanks. let's aim to have PRs for B and C by EOD and revert pinned for the next release. small follow-ups: add an integration test that runs `tools/normalize-generated.js` in CI to ensure future generator changes don't affect semver detectors.
oscar: added to my PR checklist.
arjun: rerunning publish job after pin: job #4911 started by arjun (retest).
ci-bot: job #4911 passed tests, blocked at publish step pending regen-check label.
nina: will manually verify generated outputs then remove the pin and merge fixes. thanks folks :rocket:
